request: Allow SCM to correct item names when saving a stock response, including requests awaiting customer confirmation; keep corrected vendor names consistent with the line.
acceptance: An SCM stock response exposes a required Item name input, prefilled with the current productName, while the request is awaiting customer confirmation.
Saving a corrected productName and vendorName updates the line product name and brand together, with one case revision and an audit record of the prior names.
Omitting productName preserves compatibility with existing response callers; explicit blank or over-500-character names are rejected.
A stale revision, mixed vendor, foreign line, or invalid later line rejects the whole save without partial name, stock, audit, or revision changes.
Readiness checks retain their current fields and issued-order protections; name editing uses the existing pre-SO stock response workflow.
Quantities, Sales prices, discounts, packing and customer decisions are preserved by a spelling correction.
The actual browser posts the corrected name, preserves edits after a failed save, and escapes the saved text.
The stock-check HTTP endpoint saves the name only for authenticated SCM, rejecting unauthenticated, Sales-role and stale requests.
SPREQ-000016 line 25 is corrected from best wat to BWS using its already-recorded vendor, preserving its item name and stock details, with an audit entry.

failureModel.lost edits: revision and atomic batch rollback integration tests
failureModel.unsafe names: blank, length, Unicode and HTML browser/property tests
failureModel.vendor divergence: case and line consistency integration tests
failureModel.issued order mismatch: existing SO lock integration tests and browser absence of item-name editing after SO creation
failureModel.price or quantity changes: integration assertions and affected existing quote/pricing tests

setup: Use existing Node, PostgreSQL, Playwright, ESLint, TypeScript, c8 and fast-check in the isolated test runner. No dependencies, migrations or commits. Capture source and test baselines; release only the four changed runtime files to the existing test site with rollback.
